title: When to Ask, When to Answer: Strategic Clarification for Ambiguous Reference Resolution in Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2611.05517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For humans, referential disambiguation is a collaborative process involving clarification questions asked when they will meaningfully change the outcome. However, large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be biased toward premature answering, preferring definite single-turn responses over more clarification exchanges. In this paper, we study the problem of "strategic clarification" -- asking clarification questions in a reference game when their answers will narrow the set of candidate referents. We construct a controlled test environment from the SIMMC 2.1 dataset that records how many questions each ambiguous reference needs to be successfully resolved, and examine how baseline LLM behavior and common post-training methods ask clarifying questions vs. attempt to answer the referent. translated_title: 何时提问，何时回答：对话中歧义指代消解的策略性澄清
translated_abstract: 对人类而言，指代消歧是一个协作过程，人们只在澄清问题能够实质性改变结果时才会提出这些问题。然而，已有研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）存在过早作答的偏差，更倾向于给出确定的单轮回答，而非进行更多的澄清式交流。本文研究“策略性澄清”问题——即在指代游戏中，当澄清问题的答案能够缩小候选指称对象的集合时才提出澄清问题。我们基于 SIMMC 2.1 数据集构建了一个受控测试环境，该环境记录了每个歧义指代需要多少个问题才能被成功消解，并考察了基线 LLM 行为和常见后训练方法在“提出澄清问题”与“尝试回答指代”之间的表现。我们还提出了 BACE（Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking，具有认知追踪的信念感知评论器），这是一种在冻结 LM 骨干之上的轻量级动作选择方法，并展示了……
tldr: 该论文提出“策略性澄清”任务并基于 SIMMC 2.1 构建了可控评测环境，同时提出轻量级的 BACE 动作选择方法，让 LLM 学会在澄清问题能缩小候选指代范围时才提问、否则直接回答，以缓解其过早作答的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the task of "strategic clarification" with a controlled benchmark built on SIMMC 2.1, and proposes BACE, a lightweight belief-aware action chooser atop a frozen LM backbone, enabling LLMs to ask clarifying questions only when their answers narrow the candidate referents, thereby mitigating their bias toward premature answering.
